email_messages.subject: GreenLedger Summit 2026 - registration confirmed (J. Blake)
email_messages.body:
SIMULATION ONLY.

Your registration is confirmed.

Venue: Pier 27 Conference Center, San Francisco, CA
Dates: Tuesday 17 - Thursday 19 February 2026
Registration: USD 845.00 (paid)

Your badge includes:
- all plenary and track sessions, 17-19 February
- the hosted delegate lunch on Wednesday 18 February, 12:30, Bay Hall
- morning and afternoon coffee service

Not included: breakfast, dinner, and any evening receptions hosted by exhibitors.
We do not arrange accommodation; a list of hotels near the venue is on the event site.
